correctness.rationale: Exact quantifier ranks and the separation by pencils follow directly from incidence counts. The enhanced-diagram EF strategy is established by at-most-three distinguished-line configurations in the first four moves and empty/singleton/intersection existence estimates on the fifth. Explicit bounds are positive at the sharp thresholds q>=3 for rank four and q>=4 for rank five. The checker independently computes rank-four and rank-five root types at orders 2,3,4,5; its full-versus-reduced fifth-move check has 0 mismatches among 42^4 tuples at order 4. The infinite theorem does not depend on extrapolation.
